claims.head: Good looks against hopeful ones
claims.body: On shot quality, St. Louis is one of the league’s best and Chicago is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.gist: The Blues and the Blackhawks sit at opposite ends for shot quality.
claims.call: The Blues’ shots are more dangerous on average than the Blackhawks’.

claims.head: The Blues hit; the Blackhawks mostly don’t
claims.body: The Blues are around the middle of the league for physicality, at the bruising end; the Blackhawks are one of the league’s worst, at the finesse end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Blues and the Blackhawks sit at opposite ends for physicality.
claims.call: The Blues hit more than the Blackhawks in the close stretches of the game.

CHI.head: Not an easy night for Chicago
CHI.body: St. Louis has controlled the play far better over recent games and Chicago has home ice. Chicago’s best way through is a penalty kill that holds up.

STL.head: St. Louis has a lot going for them
STL.body: St. Louis has controlled the play far better over recent games and Chicago has home ice. Chicago can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

story.head: Round two in Chicago
paras: The Blackhawks won the first meeting this season, 4-2 in Chicago. The Blues come in at 1-2-0, the Blackhawks at 1-3-0.
